procedure.method: Fresh independent review. I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, runner and summarizer, and read the three pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded source/input/final paths. Python SHA-256 and PNG IHDR checks matched the declared bytes and dimensions. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected-layout manifests. I then actually displayed each of the nine exact pinned PNGs, in packet member order M1, M2, M3 and native, usage720, thumbnail320 order within each, using tools.view_image through functions.exec and image(..., original) at original detail. These nine displays were complete before the first transcription comparison, image score or diversity score. Transcriptions below are my first raw readings retained from those displays; no ambiguity revisit was needed. No external source, prior review, author intent, or runtime thread identifier was used.

hierarchy.location: top agenda above headline and central event stack

hierarchy.location: centre metadata between title and illustration

typography.location: top programme rows and central bilingual title
typography.observation: The programme preserves all bilingual wording in aligned single-line rows. The Korean headline is bold and clear; the English title uses a dense bold line with a red Data emphasis.

space.location: top edge and central identity pocket
space.observation: The first programme row starts only about 17 pixels below the top. After the agenda, the large title and seven smaller identity/organiser lines pack into the irregular white opening above the folded scene; that opening gives the venue little breathing room.

space.location: bottom cards versus upper central stack
space.observation: The two spacious rounded cards have generous internal margins, while the upper centre is substantially denser. This uneven allocation leaves the key date/venue less comfortably spaced than the support details.

image_material.location: folded scene, hands and central seam
image_material.observation: Strong outlines, shaded hands, yellow facade, mint street panel and small pedestrians share one illustration language. Fold edges and the red separating seam remain legible, and paving perspective gives the spatial model depth.

emotion_control.observation: Yellow and mint panels, blue clothing/links and red title emphasis produce an active workshop-like mood. The large act of handling the city representation makes participation concrete, with navy rules retaining a professional register.

ai_slop.observation: Hands visibly grip the folded edges, buildings and benches remain recognisable, and the scene uses no fabricated place names, scale, coordinates or numerical data. The red line follows the fold boundary and is not labelled as a real route.
